source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of Venus

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Warnings attached to lordship of the 2nd/7th (maraka), named diseases, deaths and the remedial rituals that close each section are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

rules.text: Venus-Venus: a strong Venus in an angle, trine or the 11th — wealth and livestock through learned people, great joy at the birth of a child, welfare at home, respect, official honours and high position.

Venus-Venus: with Venus exalted or in its own sign — a new house, fine food, happiness from spouse and children, entertaining friends, charity, a vehicle through official favour, high business profits, and journeys to the west.
Venus-Venus: Venus in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th with benefic influence or with the 11th lord — gains from authority, great festivity, and growing welfare, wealth and family happiness.
Venus-Venus: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th under malefic influence — risk of theft and injury, resentment among those one works with or commands, and distress around siblings, spouse and children.

Venus-Sun: the Sun exalted, in its own or a friend's sign, or in an angle, trine, the 2nd or 11th, and well placed from Venus — gains of money, high position, comfort from spouse, wealth and luxuries, great support from the employer, welcome visits from friends, affection from parents, a rise in fortune and the birth of a child.

Venus-Sun: with the Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th or debilitated — mental anguish, quarrels with siblings and harsh words daily, discomfort for the father, opposition in official circles, unease at home and damage to house or farmland; health needs care.

Venus-Moon: with the Moon in an angle, trine or the 11th, exalted or in its own sign, ruling the 9th or 10th, or with a benefic — a vehicle, great happiness at home, luxury through official favour, pilgrimage and devotion; also music, the company of scholars, more ornaments and livestock, business success, and meals shared with siblings.

variants.text: The Moon is also well placed from Venus: official goodwill, more land, patience, fame, a vehicle, clothes and ornaments, wells and gardens built, and accumulated wealth; comfort at the start with some distress towards the end.

rules.text: Venus-Moon: the Moon debilitated, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the ascendant or from Venus — at the start a temporary loss of money, fearfulness, physical and mental strain, official opposition, foreign travel and pilgrimage, distress to spouse and children, and friction with friends and partners.

Venus-Mars: with Mars in an angle, trine or the 11th, exalted or in its own sign, or with the 1st, 9th or 10th lord — attainment of authority, wealth and property, clothes, ornaments, land and the things one most wants.

Venus-Mars: Mars in the 8th or 12th from the ascendant or from Venus — health needing care for self and parents, loss of place, mental distress, quarrels, confrontation with authority and officials, heavy expenditure and depletion of stores.

Venus-Rahu: with Rahu in an angle, trine or the 11th, exalted, or aspected by benefics — great happiness, wealth and prosperity, visits from affectionate siblings, tasks accomplished through travel, and gains of money and livestock.

Venus-Rahu: with Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th — a pleasant period: rivals overcome, great exuberance and official goodwill in the first five months, good fortune, successful touring, a return visit abroad and benefit from pilgrimage, with some obstruction and tension on journeys; health needs care at the end.
Venus-Rahu: Rahu in the 8th or 12th from Venus or with a malefic — an inauspicious time for the parents and oneself, with public resentment of every kind.

Venus-Jupiter: with Jupiter exalted or in its own sign, or in an angle, the 5th or the 9th — money recovered from a lost cause, the income one hoped for, clothes and property, honour from friends and those in power, a fine vehicle, a meeting with a learned patron, deep study of the scriptures, celebration of a child's birth and happiness from parents and children.
Venus-Jupiter: Jupiter in the 6th or 12th from Venus or with malefics — trouble from authority, theft and siblings, loss of composure through quarrels, and foreign travel; health needs care.

Venus-Mercury: with Mercury in an angle, trine or the 11th, or exalted or in its own sign — auspiciousness, the goodwill of authority, a rise in fortune, the birth of a child, money earned honestly, study of the ancient texts, the company of poets, celebration at the visits of loved ones, and great affection from the employer.

Venus-Mercury: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Venus, weak, or under malefic influence — loss of livestock, having to live in someone else's house, mental unease and losses in business. The start is favourable, the middle average and the end distressing.

Venus-Ketu: with Ketu in its own or exalted sign — very good results at the start: fine food, great success in business, more livestock, prosperity, gains of money and victory in contests; the middle is average and the end again happy.

Venus-Ketu: Ketu in the 6th or 8th from Venus or with a malefic — risk of theft and injury, clouded judgement, great fear and mental distress, disputes at work, expenses of many kinds, opposition from spouse and children, journeys and failed ventures.
